turns.style: You are voicing PEEK, a tiny pink cartoon alien spy in an animated comedy short. Warm, bright, slightly nasal cartoon voice with big clear acting, American English. He is secretly filing a field report to his Commander over the radio, hiding on top of a tall shelf in a closed superstore at night, among boxes of pillows. Dry, deadpan and a little smug, like a tiny detective narrating; brisk, clear, no dead air; every joke is delivered completely straight and he never laughs. Slightly hushed, as if he might be overheard.
turns.text: Commander. Field report number four. <short pause> I dropped a bowling ball and an apple. Same height, same moment. They landed together. Right next to an agent. <short pause> Remember report one: the heavier the thing, the harder the pull. The ball is forty times heavier than the apple, so their planet pulls on it forty times harder. <short pause> Theory: forty times the pull, forty times faster. <short pause> Wrong. They land together. Every time. Because the ball...
